participation.context: Read the papers through to the wall, and drew the line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You read from the first gage to the castle wall. You left the joins as marks. You drew a line in a margin and added no words beside it.

title: Read the king to the castle wall and drew a margin line

description: The deposing, the prison, the end

participation.context: Wrote the note and did not draft the three things.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote the three unfinished things down, and you did not draft them. You left the speech under its line. You stopped.

title: Named the deposing, the prison and the end
